module: "Delivery > Parcels" career debug tab. 'Parcel Debug' ImGui window showing, for each delivery facility (all, the nearest within a 50 m radius, or a chosen one), the header, the outgoing (outCargo) and incoming (inCargo) parcels. The entry '> Available parcel per facility' prints to the console the number of available parcels per tier (L1 to L5) and per facility.
notes: Development tool; the delivery modules are referenced in onCareerActivated.
The helpers drawFacilityHeader/OutCargo/InCargo are reused by cargoFluidDebug and vehOfferDebug.
The 'auto' mode compares squared distances with the threshold 2500 (i.e. 50 m).

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook: stores the delivery modules (parcelManager, cargoScreen, general, generator, progress, vehicleOfferManager).

drawDebugFunctions.desc: Entry '> Available parcel per facility': counts the non-expired/non-delivered parcels per minimum tier (according to career_modules_delivery_parcelMods.lockedBecauseOfMods) and prints the sorted table.

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the 'Parcel Debug' window: delivery time, facility choice (all, auto, or id) then the tables of the selected facilities.

drawFacilityHeader.desc: Draws the header (table) of a delivery facility: name, storages and generation information.

drawFacilityOutCargo.desc: Draws the table of a facility's outgoing parcels (Id, Name…).

drawFacilityInCargo.desc: Draws the table of a facility's incoming parcels (Id, Name, Slots…).
